invariants.rationale: The background parameter is used to call draw, so it should not be null.
The batch parameter is passed to background.draw and should not be null.
Width is generally non-negative when passed to drawing routines.
Height is generally non-negative when passed to drawing routines.
If background is visible, its minimum width should be less than or equal to the provided width (assumes isVisible and getMinWidth are Drawable methods).
